svg.title: The full-screen app's Home. A header with the team, Ada's team, at team list version 2. Three panes: the servers, with prod-1 and its address; the apps on prod-1, with shop at deploy 2, running, deployed 2 minutes ago; and shop's details, with the keys to deploy this folder, roll back to deploy 1, read the logs and set secrets. The keys of the screen are on the last line.
